summary: An undone update now tells you why, and the user count is more reliable.

fixes.title: Undone updates say why
fixes.text: An update undone after its health check now says why: the app could not be read, or the new version did not start.

fixes.title: More reliable user count
fixes.text: The enabled-user count is read again when it cannot be right, for example while an on-premises sync is still writing.
